extracted.intended_audience: readers/subscribers looking for prominent Substack news newsletters and creators seeking examples of top-performing news Substacks
extracted.subtask_description: A curated list/page of Substack's top 25 news publications and podcasts; the page highlights what makes these Substacks 'top' by showing scope, audience size, recent activity, engagement, formats, and topical focus. Useful for discovering or evaluating leading Substack news newsletters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: breaking news and analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes breaking news and analysis of current events from top journalists related to politics, international relations, the law and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the page's explicit scope statement — the listed publications provide breaking news and analysis across political, international, and legal topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscriber count / audience size
rubrics_metrics.description: Prominence indicated by subscriber scale labels such as 'HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF SUBSCRIBERS' or 'TENS OF THOUSANDS OF SUBSCRIBERS'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page emphasizes large subscriber bases as a signal of 'top' status (examples shown on many entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recency / publication frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence of 'RECENT AND TOP POSTS' and timestamps like 'PUBLISHED 9 HOURS AGO', 'PUBLISHED 2 DAYS AGO', or explicit cadence statements (e.g., 'delivered directly to your inbox four times a week', 'daily', 'weekly').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Freshness and regular publishing cadence are highlighted for many publications and used to show active, up-to-date coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement metrics (likes, restacks, comments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Displayed engagement counts such as 'LIKES', 'RESTACKS', and 'COMMENTS' (e.g., '35740 LIKES 2245 RESTACKS 14772 COMMENTS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page surfaces social/reader engagement as an indicator of popularity and impact; these figures are shown prominently for posts and popular items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigative / original reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Emphasis on investigative journalism and original reporting (examples: 'Investigative Journalism. Anti-Corruption. Whistleblowers. Sunlight.'; 'Public has broken major stories').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several listings advertise original scoops and deep investigations as a defining quality for top newsletters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical focus / subject-matter coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear topical specializations such as politics, China coverage, Supreme Court rulings, local news, international relations, law, corruption, and public policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each entry identifies the publication's beats (e.g., China for Sinocism; Supreme Court for One First; local London reporting for London Centric), signaling that subject focus is a consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credibility / trust and authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims of being 'trusted by diplomats, policymakers, investors, executives, journalists & academics' or being founded by 'award-winning journalist', indicating reputational authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page highlights trust signals (expert readership, awards, journalist reputation) as part of a publication's stature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format diversity (podcast, live video, transcripts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many listings include audio/video formats and episodes (podcasts, live video, transcripts) in addition to email newsletters (examples: 'Sharp China' podcast, 'Top podcasts', 'live video').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia offerings are presented as part of a publication's value and reach (audio episodes, video, transcripts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent / subscriber-supported model
rubrics_metrics.description: Self-description like 'independent, subscriber-supported publication' or 'subscribe' call-to-action indicates funding/model as a trait.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page treats subscription-supported independence as a notable characteristic of several top Substacks (e.g., Fix The News).

rubrics_metrics.name: Local vs. national/regional focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of local outlets that focus on city/state-level reporting (examples: 'London Centric', 'The Dakota Scout').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top lists include both local-focused newsrooms and national/international outlets — scope of geographic focus is a distinguishing factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opinionated / advocacy voice vs. neutral reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Some publications present an explicitly advocacy or opinion-driven mission ('I write about genocide, police brutality, corruption, and global injustice — and I name names'; 'Don't give in to the lies. Hold on to the truth!').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tone and stated editorial stance (opinion/advocacy vs. straight reporting) are used in descriptions and help define the outlet's positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prominence of host/journalist
rubrics_metrics.description: Many entries list well-known journalists or hosts (e.g., Jim Acosta, Katie Couric, Julie K. Brown, Seymour Hersh) as a mark of authority and draw.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual journalist recognition and prior achievements are highlighted as reasons for prominence and subscriber interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community / access features
rubrics_metrics.description: Community elements such as 'access to an elite community of China watchers through regular online discussions', 'the Sinocism chat in the Substack app', and interactive elements (comments, live Q&A).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community access and interactive features (chats, discussions, comment interaction) are presented as added value for subscribers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusive / breaking scoops
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings emphasize exclusives and breaking stories ('Public has broken major stories', 'Exclusive: ... New documents show'), framing exclusivity as a distinguishing feature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exclusive investigations and scoops are repeatedly used in descriptions to signal high news value and justify top placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of 'popular post' highlights
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry often displays a 'POPULAR POST' with engagement counts and a short excerpt or title to showcase noteworthy recent coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlighting a single 'popular post' is used as a curation tactic to illustrate the publication's tone, reach, and kind of stories that resonate with readers.
